info.name: Keycloak Mock API v26.0.5
info.description:
Test collection for the mock Keycloak service. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8117. In docker-compose, the service is reachable at http://keycloak-api:8117.

Everything is scoped to a **realm**, and nothing crosses the boundary. `/realms/{realm}/protocol/openid-connect/...` is what a client talks to; `/admin/realms/{realm}/...` is the Admin REST API.

The direct grant (`grant_type=password`) is Keycloak's first-class login, and it fails in four different ways, each with the message Keycloak really returns: a wrong password (401 'Invalid user credentials'), a disabled account (400 'Account disabled'), pending required actions (400 'Account is not fully set up') and a brute-force lock (401, deliberately identical to a wrong password).

Two realms are seeded: `orbit-labs` and `orbit-partners`. Tokens: the master admin token `kc-at-master-admin-cli-8f0c31d47a92` administers any realm; `kc-at-amelia-ui-6b40d2a97f15` holds realm-admin in orbit-labs; `kc-at-jonas-ui-2f83b0e6c194` holds only `view-users`, inherited through the `/platform` group's composite role. Requests labelled '(N expected)' assert an error path.
